messages:
rachel-sales: NorthHarbor is ready to move to a POC but their security team asked for SOC2 artifacts, ISO scope statement, a signed pen-test attestation, and (ideally) the raw findings. They want dev on Hosted and prod on Dedicated with separate billing. Can we confirm what we can provide and any contract or pricing blockers?

tom-eng: For a POC we can provide: redacted SOC2 Type II summary, ISO 27001 scope statement (redacted), system/network diagrams, and a remediation status sheet. We don't hand over raw pen-test output without NDA and a dataroom workflow. For Dedicated we can spin up a short reserved pool but need capacity lead time (usually 24-48h) and a minimal daily pro-rate.

priya-sec: We will sign the pen-test attestation once the scope is confirmed. If they want findings, require NDA signed by their legal entity + approved redaction plan. Also need the pen-test firm name, scan window, and target IP/CIDR to whitelist.

nate-ops: Billing split is fine: Hosted per-token + Dedicated reserved node pro-rated. For POCs we typically do a weekly reserved fee plus usage. Need expected concurrent QPS and avg tokens/request to quote. If they want Dedicated in ap-south or eu-west that can affect lead time.

claire-legal: We cannot provide raw vulnerability exports by default. Our standard path: 1) attestation letter using internal template, 2) summary of findings and remediation status. For full findings we require an executed NDA and SOW amendment covering data handling. I'll attach the pen-test letter template after this thread.

rachel-sales: Can someone paste a minimal ask template I can send to NorthHarbor so we get everything in one reply?

tom-eng: Paste this:

``nPlease provide:
- Pen-test scope: external / internal / both
- Pen-test firm name + contact + signatory for attestation
- Scan window dates and target IPs/CIDRs
- Do you require raw findings or attestation only? If findings, attach executed NDA
- POC traffic: expected concurrent QPS and avg tokens per request
- Regions: Hosted region and Dedicated region (if different)
- SSO: API keys or SAML/OIDC?
- Procurement contact for vendor form
```

priya-sec: We'll open evidence ticket once they confirm. Also: if they ask for KMS key usage logs or host-level debug logs, escalate to legal + contracts.

evidence-bot: Created EVD-7742 to assemble SOC2 summary, ISO scope doc, diagrams, and pen-test attestation when inputs received. Owner: @priya-sec.

rachel-sales: Thanks all. I'll send the template now and request NDA if they want findings. Expect reply by Tue EOD and will loop procurement if they ask for vendor form.

tom-eng: standing by to schedule reserved pool once QPS + region are confirmed.

priya-sec: once they confirm scope i'll draft the attestation and share for legal sign-off. :thumbsup:
